$comment: W0-6 taxonomy map. The dataset's `category` string is matched against an EXISTING category
row by unaccent+lower of Name (D03: a raw string match would create an eleventh category the
moment one row carries a typo such as 'Laptop - May Tinh Xach Tay' with the wrong accent).
Categories are ENRICHED IN PLACE, never re-created: content.HomepageSections.Configuration
embeds 6 categoryId + 5 brandId as raw UUIDs in JSON with no FK, so changing an Id silently
kills the homepage. Total category count after import must stay 10.
`subCategory` is NOT a category row in wave 0 - it is written to Products.Attributes.subCategory
so W2-1 can build the facet without a schema change.
isSerialTracked comes from the D08 matrix. It is a CATEGORY-level flag, so the mixed rows are
resolved by majority and noted below.
